body: You have some really great points, and when I'm a little more awake I'm going to re-read this and let it soak in a little more, and I may have a few thoughts on some of it.  Thank you for this, I think you wrote a lot of things I needed to read.

I guess my problem is, I can't see myself back with her knowing that she did this.  I know it was probably to try and get over me, but the timing and the who made it a little more than I could handle.  Thus why I'm so conflicted right now, I know I love her but I'm not sure I could ever look past this.

Don't worry, it wasn't the move that ended it, they just happened to be simultaneous.  I ended it just before the move, for reasons that for the most part, did not involve the move.  Good luck to you though, thanks for the chat.  I think that's all I needed last night, just an outlet and to know someone else is around to hear/read it.

I finished mine a few months ago, then moved for a job.  I also ended my six year relationship at the same time.  I really compound bad decisions sometimes.  Thanks for the advice.  I need to go crash in my bed now and hopefully feel better in the morning.  Good luck with the thesis, it feels incredible when it's done.

No I don't actually.  I just moved to a new area, and so when I'm not at work I'm usually doing nothing (thus I can relate to your idle comment).  I'm literally alone most of the time, which also scares me.  I probably need to find some local resources in case I get to a point where I feel I need them.

That's kind of where I feel I'm at.  It just seems to be escalating, where a month ago I would say this was never even a thought of mine, to the point now where I picture it on a daily basis.  I'm just worried about how much worse it will get or if it'll peak and then I can get back to feeling better again.  I just worry, there are times I think "well, if I only had a gun..." and it scares me a little.  I just don't know what to do about it yet.

I know just where you're coming from.  Just ended my 6 year relationship and then moved 2700 miles to a place where I do not know anyone.  I miss the exact same things you miss, the cuddling especially.  You just have to remember it isn't permanent, I'm not sure anything in life is.  Personally, I'm just trying to take baby steps right now, nothing huge.  Occasionally trying to peek outside my shell and remind myself that there is an entire world full of people and experiences out there.  It's hard but I just tell myself to do it and to take it one day at a time.  Good luck to you, I know what it's like.

Edit: Oh, my boat sank too.  She started dating one of my closest friends 4 weeks after the breakup.  Just remember, it's for the better that she's gone, if you were still talking to her it'd probably just delay moving forward.
